purpose: Convert the completed AirSense V2 research program into a strict, publication-ready evidence structure. Phase 10 synthesises and freezes; it performs no scientific experimentation.
manuscript_drafting_phase: Phase 11, only after Phase 10 is validated and human-reviewed
permitted_operations: parse frozen JSON and CSV artifacts
recompute an already-defined metric solely for integrity verification
reproduce an already-implied relative comparison from frozen exact values
forbidden_operations: calculate a metric never previously frozen
define a new subgroup or event type
run a new bootstrap or significance test
create a new leaderboard or winner label
train, refit, load or run any model

evidence_classes.C1: LOCKED CONFIRMATORY - obtained under the Phase-8 frozen final-test hierarchy
evidence_classes.C2: DEVELOPMENT / ROBUSTNESS SUPPORTED - development validation, training-only tuning, multi-seed robustness or LOSO, all before final-test opening
evidence_classes.C3: POST-TEST EXPLORATORY - first generated during Phase 9, after the test had been evaluated
evidence_classes.C4: HISTORICAL V1 - from the frozen AirSense V1 program
evidence_classes.C5: METHODOLOGICAL / GOVERNANCE - dataset integrity, leakage control, pretraining audit, validator provenance, test sealing, reproducibility

class_rule: No Phase-9 finding may be presented as C1.

git_anchors.phase9_closure_subject: Freeze AirSense V2 post-test exploratory analysis

prohibited_claims: GRU beats persistence in severe pollution
all hypotheses were confirmed on the final test
V2 improves V1 by a percentage
the model is operationally ready for early warning
a formal bias-variance decomposition was performed
